description: Takes one card out of the freezer, back to What needs you, as Take it out does there. It comes back saying its age first: how old the thread is, how long ago the trend stopped being current, the day the post was for (a post comes back without its day: its yes sends it at the next free time). It never goes back in by itself. Free. It needs an act key.

card_id.description: the frozen card's id, from freezer_read

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
